## #1 Set Seed

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

## #2 Load Packages

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(here)
```

## #3 Choose Scenarios

```{r}
nint_values = c(20, 41, 56)
names(nint_values) = c("Default", "Worst Case Scenario", "Best Case Scenario")
```

## #4 Simulated Effect Data Function

```{r}
simulated_data <- function(target_corr=0, noise_mean = 0, noise_sd = 0.3) {

  cor_matrix <- matrix(
    c(
      1,   target_corr, target_corr,
      target_corr, 1,   0.7,
      target_corr, 0.7, 1
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  effects <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = nint,
    mu = c(0, 0, 0),
    Sigma = cor_matrix
  )
  
  #Add Noise to Data
  noise1 = rnorm(nint, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  noise2 = rnorm(nint, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  noise3 = rnorm(nint, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  
  effects[,1] = effects[,1] + noise1
  effects[,2] = effects[,2] + noise2
  effects[,3] = effects[,3] + noise3
  
  return(effects)
}
```

## #5 Correlation Function

```{r}
corr <- function(df, met="pearson") {
  
  corr_c = cor(df$Lifespan_Effect, df$Chronological_Effect, method = met)
  corr_m = cor(df$Lifespan_Effect, df$Mortality_Effect, method = met)
  
  delta_corr = corr_m - corr_c
  
  return (delta_corr)
}
```

## #6 Simulate 1000 Times

```{r}
target_corr_values <- c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9)

results <- data.frame()

for (scenario in names(nint_values)) {
  
  nint <- nint_values[scenario]
  
  potencia <- data.frame(
    Intervention = paste0("Drug_", 1:nint),
    Lifespan_Effect = numeric(nint),
    Chronological_Effect = numeric(nint),
    Mortality_Effect = numeric(nint)
  )
  
  for (target in target_corr_values) {
    
    delta_corr_values <- replicate(1000, {
      effects <- simulated_data(target)
      df <- potencia
      df[, 2:4] <- effects
      corr(df)
    })
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Scenario = scenario,
      nint = nint,
      target_corr = target,
      Mean_DeltaR = mean(delta_corr_values),
      Percentile_Range =
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.975) -
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.025)
    ))
  }
}

results
```

## #7 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(results, here("results","potencia_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
